headline: Globus Spirits Limited: Allotment of 2,380,952 securities under QIP
sum: Globus Spirits completed allotment of 2.38 million securities under Qualified Institution Placement (QIP) on 6 August 2026 following shareholder/board approval, marking the closing of its institutional capital raise.
detail: Globus Spirits, a spirits and alcoholic beverages manufacturer, allotted 2,380,952 equity shares under QIP mechanics at its board meeting on 6 August 2026. QIP is a preferential issuance route available to listed companies to raise capital from qualified institutional buyers (FIIs, MFs, banks, insurers) without needing prior shareholder approval for pricing, subject to existing shareholder mandate and SEBI regulations. The allotment represents the formal issuance event; pricing and number of shares would have been determined by the company in consultation with its QIP underwriters. Standard 6-month lock-in applies to certain investor tranches under QIP rules.
